analyzed: atas avayava karma avayava antarāt eva vibhāgam ārabhate tatas vibhāgāt ca dravya ārambhaka samyoga vināśaḥ tasmin vinaṣṭe kāraṇa abhāvāt kārya abhāvaḥ iti avayavi vināśaḥ tadā kāraṇayoḥ vartamānaḥ vibhāgaḥ kārya vināśa viśiṣṭam kālam svatantram vā avayavam apekṣya sa kriyasya eva avayavasya kārya samyuktāt ākāśa ādi deśāt vibhāgam ārabhate na niṣkriyasya kāraṇa abhāvāt uttara samyoga anutpattau anupabhogya tva prasaṅgaḥ na tu tad avaya

original: 8.10: kāraṇākāraṇavibhāgād api katham /

original: 8.10: yadā haste karmotpannam avayavāntarād vibhāgam akurvadākāśādideśebhyo vibhāgān ārabhya pradeśāntare samyogān ārabhate tadā te kāraṇākāraṇavibhāgāḥ karma yām diśam prati kāryārambhābhimukham tām apekṣya kāryākāryavibhāgān ārabhante tadanantaram kāraṇākāraṇasamyogāc ca kāryākāryasamyogān iti /

original: 8.10: yutasiddhyaparijñānāt/ sā punar dvayor anyatarasya vā pṛthaggatimattvam iyantu nityānām anityānām tu yuteṣv āśrayeṣu samavāyo yutasiddhir iti /
analyzed: yuta siddhi aparijñānāt sā punar dvayoḥ anyatarasya vā pṛthak gatimat tvam iyat tu nityānām anityānām tu yuteṣu āśrayeṣu samavāyaḥ yuta siddhiḥ iti

original: 8.10: tvagindriyaśarīrayoḥ pṛthaggatimattvam nāsti yuteṣv āśrayeṣu samavāyostīti paraspareṇa samyogaḥ siddhaḥ/ aṇvākāśayos tv āśrayāntarābhāvepy anyatarasya pṛthaggatimattvāt samyogavibhāgau siddhau /
analyzed: tvac indriya śarīrayoḥ pṛthak gatimat tvam na asti yuteṣu āśrayeṣu samavāyaḥ asti iti paraspareṇa samyogaḥ siddhaḥ aṇu ākāśayoḥ tu āśraya antara abhāve pi anyatarasya pṛthak gatimat tvāt samyoga vibhāgau siddhau

original: 8.10: tantupaṭayor anityayor āśrayāntarābhāvāt parasparataḥ samyogavibhāgābhāva iti / digādīnām tu pṛthaggatimattvābhāvād iti paraspareṇa samyogavibhāgābhāva iti /
analyzed: tantu paṭayoḥ anityayoḥ āśraya antara abhāvāt parasparataḥ samyoga vibhāga abhāvaḥ iti diś ādīnām tu pṛthak gatimat tva abhāvāt iti paraspareṇa samyoga vibhāga abhāvaḥ iti

original: 8.10: vināśas tu sarvasya vibhāgasya kṣaṇikatvād uttarasamyogāvadhisadbhāvād kṣaṇika iti /

original: 8.10: na tu samyogavidyayor eva vibhāgas tayor eva samyogād vināśo bhavati kasmāt samyuktapratyayavadvibhaktapratyayānuvṛttyabhāvāt tasmād uttarasamyogāvadhisadbhāvāt kṣaṇika iti /

original: 8.10: kvacic cāśrayavināśād eva vinaśyatīti / katham /

original: 8.10: yadā dvitantukakāraṇāvayave aṃśau karmotpannam aṃśvantarād vibhāgām ārabhate tadaiva tantvantare'pi karmotpadyate vibhāgāc ca tantvārambhakasamyogavināśaḥ tantukarmaṇā tantvantarād vibhāgaḥ kriyate ity ekaḥ kālaḥ /

original: 8.10: tato yasminn eva kāle vibhāgāt tantusamyogavināśaḥ tasminn eva kāle samyogavināśāt tantuvināśas tasmin vinaṣṭe tadāśritasya tantvantaravibhāgasya vināśa iti/ evam tarhy uttaravibhāgānutpattiprasaṅgaḥ /
analyzed: tatas yasmin eva kāle vibhāgāt tantu samyoga vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle samyoga vināśāt tantu vināśaḥ tasmin vinaṣṭe tad āśritasya tantu antara vibhāgasya vināśaḥ iti evam tarhi uttara vibhāga anutpatti prasaṅgaḥ

original: 8.10: kāraṇavibhāgābhāvāt/ tataḥ pradeśāntarasamyogavati samyogābhāva ity ato virodhiguṇāsambhavāt karmaṇaś cirakālāvasthāyitvam nityadravyasamavetasya ca nityatvam iti doṣaḥ / katham /

original: 8.10: yadāpyadvyaṇukārambhakaparamāṇau karmotpannam aṇvantarād vibhāgam karoti tadaivāṇvantare 'pi karma tato yasminn eva kāle vibhāgād dravyārambhakasamyogavināśaḥ tadaivāṇvantarakarmaṇā dvyaṇukāṇvor vibhāgaḥ kriyate tato yasminn eva kāle vibhāgāt dvyuaṇukāṇusamyogasya vināśaḥ tasminn eva kāle samyogavināśāt dvyaṇukasya vināśaḥ
analyzed: yadā api a dvi aṇuka ārambhaka paramāṇau karma utpannam aṇu antarāt vibhāgam karoti tadā eva aṇu antare pi karma tatas yasmin eva kāle vibhāgāt dravya ārambhaka samyoga vināśaḥ tadā eva aṇu antara karmaṇā dvyaṇuka aṇvoḥ vibhāgaḥ kriyate tatas yasmin eva kāle vibhāgāt dvi uaṇuka aṇu samyogasya vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle samyoga vināśāt dvyaṇukasya vināśaḥ

original: 8.10: tasmin vinaṣṭe tadāśritasya dvyaṇukāṇuvibhāgasya vināśaḥ tataś ca virodhiguṇāsambhavān nityadravyasamavetakarmaṇo nityatvam iti /
analyzed: tasmin vinaṣṭe tad āśritasya dvi aṇuka aṇu vibhāgasya vināśaḥ tatas ca virodhi guṇa asambhavāt nitya dravya samaveta karmaṇaḥ nitya tvam iti

original: 8.10: tantvaṃśvantaravibhāgād vibhāga ity adoṣaḥ / āśrayavināśāt tantvor eva vibhāgo vinaṣṭo na tantvaṃśvantaravibhāga iti etasmād uttaro vibhāgo jāyate aṅgulyākāśavibhāgāc charīrākāśavibhāgavat tasminn eva kāle karma samyogam kṛtvā vinaśyatīty adoṣaḥ /
analyzed: tantu aṃśu antara vibhāgāt vibhāgaḥ iti adoṣaḥ āśraya vināśāt tantvoḥ eva vibhāgaḥ vinaṣṭaḥ na tantu aṃśu antara vibhāgaḥ iti etasmāt uttaraḥ vibhāgaḥ jāyate aṅguli ākāśa vibhāgāt śarīra ākāśa vibhāga vat tasmin eva kāle karma samyogam kṛtvā vinaśyati iti adoṣaḥ

original: 8.10: athavā aṃśvantaravibhāgotpattisamakālam tasminn eva tantau karmotpadyate tatoṃśvantaravibhāgāt tantvārambhakasamyogavināśaḥ tantukarmaṇā ca tantvantarād vibhāgaḥ kriyate ity ekaḥ kālaḥ /
analyzed: athavā aṃśu antara vibhāga utpatti sama kālam tasmin eva tantau karma utpadyate tatas ūṃśu antara vibhāgāt tantu ārambhaka samyoga vināśaḥ tantu karmaṇā ca tantu antarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

original: 8.10: tataḥ samyogavināśāt tantuvināśaḥ tadvināśāc ca tadāśritayor vibhāgakarmaṇor yugapadvināśaḥ / tantuvīraṇayor vā samyoge sati dravyānutpattau pūrvoktena vidhānenāśrayavināśasamyogābhyām tantuvīraṇavibhāgavināśa iti //
analyzed: tatas samyoga vināśāt tantu vināśaḥ tad vināśāt ca tad āśritayoḥ vibhāga karmaṇoḥ yugapad vināśaḥ tantu vīraṇayoḥ vā samyoge sati dravya anutpattau pūrva uktena vidhānena āśraya vināśa samyogābhyām tantu vīraṇa vibhāga vināśaḥ iti

original: 8.11: paratvam aparatvam ca parāparābhidhānapratyayanimittam / tat tu dvividham dikkṛtam kālakṛtam ca/ tatra dikkṛtam digviśeṣapratyāyakam /
analyzed: paratvam aparatvam ca para apara abhidhāna pratyaya nimittam tat tu dvividham diś kṛtam kāla kṛtam ca tatra diś kṛtam diś viśeṣa pratyāyakam

original: 8.11: kālakṛtam ca vayobhedapratyāyakam/ tatra dikkṛtasyotpattir abhidhīyate / katham / ekasyām diśy avasthitayoḥ piṇḍayoḥ samyuktasamyogabahvalpabhāve saty ekasya draṣṭuḥ sannikṛṣṭam avadhim kṛtvā etasmād viprakṛṣṭo 'yam iti paratvādhāre'sannikṛṣṭā buddhir utpadyate /
analyzed: kāla kṛtam ca vayaḥ bheda pratyāyakam tatra diś kṛtasya utpattiḥ abhidhīyate katham ekasyām diśi avasthitayoḥ piṇḍayoḥ samyukta samyoga bahu alpa bhāve sati ekasya draṣṭuḥ sannikṛṣṭam avadhim kṛtvā etasmāt viprakṛṣṭaḥ yam iti paratva ādhāre sannikṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate

original: 8.11: tatas tām apekṣya pareṇa dikpradeśena samyogāt paratvasyotpattiḥ/ tathā viprakṛṣṭam cāvadhim kṛtvā etasmāt sannikṛṣṭoyam ity aparatvādhāre itarasmin sannikṛṣṭā buddhir utpadyate /
analyzed: tatas tām apekṣya pareṇa diś pradeśena samyogāt paratvasya utpattiḥ tathā viprakṛṣṭam ca avadhim kṛtvā etasmāt sannikṛṣṭaḥ yam iti aparatva ādhāre itarasmin sannikṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate

original: 8.11: tatas tām apekṣyāpareṇa dikpradeśena samyogād aparatvasyotpattiḥ / kālakṛtayor api katham /
analyzed: tatas tām apekṣya apareṇa diś pradeśena samyogāt aparatvasya utpattiḥ kāla kṛtayoḥ api katham

original: 8.11: vartamānakālayor aniyatadigdeśasamyuktayor yuvasthavirayo rūḍhaśmaśrukārkaśyabalipalitādisānnidhye saty ekasya draṣṭur yuvānam avadhim kṛtvā sthivire viprakṛṣṭā buddhir utpadyate /
analyzed: vartamāna kālayoḥ aniyata diś deśa samyuktayoḥ yuva sthavirayoḥ rūḍha śmaśru kārkaśya bali palita ādi sānnidhye sati ekasya draṣṭuḥ yuvānam avadhim kṛtvā sthivire viprakṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate

original: 8.11: tatas tām apekṣya pareṇa kālapradeśena samyogāt paratvasyotpattiḥ/ sthaviram cāvadhim kṛtvā yūni sannikṛṣṭā buddhir utpadyate / tatas tām apekṣyāpareṇa kālapradeśena samyogād aparatvasyotpattir iti /
analyzed: tatas tām apekṣya pareṇa kāla pradeśena samyogāt para tvasya utpattiḥ sthaviram ca avadhim kṛtvā yūni sannikṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate tatas tām apekṣya apareṇa kāla pradeśena samyogāt apara tvasya utpattiḥ iti

original: 8.11: vināśas tv apekṣābuddhisamyogadravyavināśāt/ apekṣābuddhivināśāt tāvad utpanne paratve yasmin kāle sāmānyabuddhir utpannā bhavati tato'pekṣābuddher vinaśyattā sāmānyajñānatatsambandhebhyaḥ paratvaguṇabuddher utpadyamānatety ekaḥ kālaḥ /
analyzed: vināśaḥ tu apekṣā buddhi samyoga dravya vināśāt apekṣā buddhi vināśāt tāvat utpanne paratve yasmin kāle sāmānya buddhiḥ utpannā bhavati tatas upekṣā buddheḥ vinaśyat tā sāmānya jñāna tad sambandhebhyaḥ paratva guṇa buddheḥ utpadyamāna tā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

original: 8.11: tato'pekṣābuddher vināśo guṇabuddheś cotpattiḥ tato'pekṣābuddhivināśād guṇasya vinaśyattā guṇajñānatatsambandhebhyo dravyabuddher utpadyamānatety ekaḥ kālaḥ / tato dravyabuddher utpattir guṇasya vināśa iti /
analyzed: tata upekṣā buddheḥ vināśaḥ guṇa buddheḥ ca utpattiḥ tata upekṣā buddhi vināśāt guṇasya vinaśyat tā guṇa jñāna tad sambandhebhyaḥ dravya buddheḥ utpadyamāna tā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas dravya buddheḥ utpattiḥ guṇasya vināśaḥ iti

original: 8.11: samyogavināśād api katham/ apekṣābuddhisamakālam eva paratvādhāre karmotpadyate tena karmaṇā dikpiṇḍavibhāgaḥ kriyate apekṣābuddhitaḥ paratvasyotpattir ity ekaḥ kālaḥ /
analyzed: samyoga vināśāt api katham apekṣā buddhi sama kālam eva paratva ādhāre karma utpadyate tena karmaṇā diś piṇḍa vibhāgaḥ kriyate apekṣā buddhitaḥ paratvasya utpattiḥ iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

original: 8.11: tataḥ sāmānyabuddhier utpattiḥ dikpiṇḍasamyogasya ca vināśaḥ tato yasmin kāle guṇabuddhir utpadyate tasminn eva kāle dikpiṇḍasamyogavināśād guṇasya vināśaḥ/ dravyavināśād api katham /
analyzed: tatas sāmānya buddhiyāḥ utpattiḥ diś piṇḍa samyogasya ca vināśaḥ tatas yasmin kāle guṇa buddhiḥ utpadyate tasmin eva kāle diś piṇḍa samyoga vināśāt guṇasya vināśaḥ dravya vināśāt api katham

original: 8.11: paratvādhārāvayave karmotpannam yasminn eva kāle'vayavāntarād vibhāgam karoti tasminn eva kāle 'pekṣābuddhir utpadyate tato vibhāgād yasminn eva kāle samyogavināśaḥ tasminn eva kāle paratvam utpadyate tataḥ samyogavināśād dravyavināśaḥ tadvināśāc ca tadāśritasya guṇasya vināśaḥ /

original: 8.11: dravyāpekṣābuddhor yugapadvināśād api katham / yadā paratvādhārāvayave karmotpadyate tadaivāpekṣābuddhir utpadyate karmaṇā cāvayavāntarād vibhāgaḥ kriyate paratvasyotpattir ity ekaḥ kālaḥ /
analyzed: dravya apekṣā buddhoḥ yugapad vināśāt api katham yadā paratva ādhāra avayave karma utpadyate tadā eva apekṣā buddhiḥ utpadyate karmaṇā ca avayava antarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate paratvasya utpattiḥ iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

original: 8.11: tato yasminn eva kāle 'vayavavibhāgād dravyārambhakasamyogavināśas tasminn eva kāle sāmānyabuddhir utpadyate tadanantaram samyogavināśād dravyavināśaḥ sāmānyabuddheś cāpekṣābuddhivināśa ity ekaḥ kālaḥ /
analyzed: tatas yasmin eva kāle vayava vibhāgāt dravya ārambhaka samyoga vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle sāmānya buddhiḥ utpadyate tad anantaram samyoga vināśāt dravya vināśaḥ sāmānya buddheḥ ca apekṣā buddhi vināśaḥ iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

original: 8.11: tato dravyāpekṣābuddhor vināśāt paratvasya vināśaḥ/ dravyasamyogavināśād api katham /
analyzed: tatas dravya apekṣā buddhoḥ vināśāt para tvasya vināśaḥ dravya samyoga vināśāt api katham

original: 8.11: yadā paratvādhārāvayave karmotpannam avayavāntarād vibhāgam karoti tasminn eva kāle piṇḍakarmāpekṣābuddhor yugapad utpattiḥ tato yasminn eva kāle paratvasyotpattis tasminn eva kāle vibhāgād dravyārambhakasamyogavināśaḥ piṇḍakarmaṇā dikpiṇḍasya ca vibhāgaḥ kriyate ity ekaḥ kālaḥ /
analyzed: yadā paratva ādhāra avayave karma utpannam avayava antarāt vibhāgam karoti tasmin eva kāle piṇḍa karma apekṣā buddhoḥ yugapad utpattiḥ tatas yasmin eva kāle paratvasya utpattiḥ tasmin eva kāle vibhāgāt dravya ārambhaka samyoga vināśaḥ piṇḍa karmaṇā diś piṇḍasya ca vibhāgaḥ kriyate iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

original: 8.11: tato yasminn eva kāle sāmānyabuddhir utpadyate tasminn eva kāle dravyārambhakasamyogavināśāt piṇḍavināśaḥ piṇḍavināśāc ca piṇḍasamyogavināśaḥ tato guṇabuddhisamakālam piṇḍadikpiṇḍasamyogavināśāt paratvasya vināśaḥ /
